# Hopsworks Documentation

> Official documentation for Hopsworks and its Feature Store - an open source data-intensive AI platform used for the development and operation of machine learning models at scale.
- [Home](https://docs.hopsworks.ai/latest/) ([md](https://docs.hopsworks.ai/latest/index.md))
- [Getting Started ↗](https://run.hopsworks.ai)
